class.name: IfcOccupant
class.brief_description: An occupant is a type of actor that defines the form of occupancy of a property. The principal purpose of IfcOccupant is to determine the nature of occupancy of a property for a particular actor. All characteristics relating to the actor (name and organization details) are inherited from the IfcActor class. HISTORY: New entity in IFC2x Assignment Use Definition The IfcOccupant may have assignments

members.member: Predefined occupant types from which that required may be set. IFC2x4 CHANGE Attribute made optional.
